subtitle: The applications and data stores inside the Recipe Planner
desc: The cook uses a Vue single-page app, which calls a FastAPI service that stores data in PostgreSQL and calls an e-mail service and Azure OpenAI.

cook.name: Home Cook
cook.description: Plans weekly meals and shops for them.

spa.name: Planner UI
spa.description: Lets the cook browse recipes and plan the week in a browser.

api.name: Planner API
api.description: Serves recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.

db.name: Recipe Database
db.description: Stores recipes, meal plans and shopping lists.

email.name: E-mail Service
email.description: Delivers shopping lists to the cook by e-mail.

aoai.name: Azure OpenAI
aoai.description: Suggests recipes from a list of ingredients.
